title: Mallworld Alien Apocalypse
content: A while ago I had a mallworld dream that focused on a hostile alien attack. These aliens were more or less humanoid and kind of reminded me of blue groots. They had some sort of blue laser weapons that would basically melt whatever it hit and they would target any human in sight. Humans would shelter within buildings located throughout mallworld and the only safe outdoor space was the beach. the "hub" building was surrounded but none of the hostile entities could enter for some reason. has anyone else experienced malicious entities in their mallworld dreams? I kept this brief because I only joined this sub recently and this dream was from a cojuple weeks ago.
